conditions.evidence: patients with stage 2 or 3 breast cancer receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy
conditions.label: stage 2 or 3 breast cancer

modalities.evidence: Multi-center breast DCE-MRI data and segmentations

output.population: Patients with stage 2 or 3 breast cancer receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy, enrolled on CALGB 150007 with T3 tumors measuring at least 3 cm; pregnant patients and those with ferromagnetic prostheses excluded
output.summary: Multi-center breast dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI with segmentations from a prospective trial testing whether MRI predicts response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy and risk of recurrence in breast cancer.
